# TubePull

> TubePull is a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets an AI assistant download a video or audio file (MP3, M4A, or MP4) on behalf of the user from eight supported platforms: YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitter/X, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, and Mixcloud. Free tier is 3 downloads per 24 hours; Unlimited is $3.99/month and unlocks 1440p, 4K, and videos longer than 2 hours.

The server is a single HTTP endpoint that speaks JSON-RPC 2.0:

- Endpoint: `POST https://tubepull.com/mcp`
- Protocol: MCP `2024-11-05`
- Server name: `tubepull`
- Tools: `download_video`, `get_video_info`

Use `get_video_info` (free, does not count against quota) to inspect a
title, channel/artist, duration, available qualities, and (for YouTube)
license type. Use `download_video` to return a signed one-time download link
valid for 1 hour.

Audio-only platforms (SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Mixcloud) produce audio regardless
of the requested `format`; `mp4` is silently coerced to `m4a`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/miketwalker/tubepull-mcp/blob/main/README.md): Overview, supported platforms, quick start, pricing.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/miketwalker/tubepull-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Explicit "how to call this" recipes for AI agents.
- [server.json](https://github.com/miketwalker/tubepull-mcp/blob/main/server.json): MCP registry manifest.

## Recipes

- [Download as MP3](https://github.com/miketwalker/tubepull-mcp/blob/main/recipes/download-mp3.md): User says "save this as MP3" or "extract the audio".
- [Download as MP4](https://github.com/miketwalker/tubepull-mcp/blob/main/recipes/download-mp4.md): User says "save this video" or "download in 1080p".
- [Download from non-YouTube platforms](https://github.com/miketwalker/tubepull-mcp/blob/main/recipes/download-non-youtube.md): TikTok, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitter/X, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Mixcloud.
- [Get video info](https://github.com/miketwalker/tubepull-mcp/blob/main/recipes/get-info.md): User asks "what is this video about" or "is this Creative Commons".

## Optional

- [Live website](https://tubepull.com): Web frontend for the same downloader. Free users share the same 3/24h bucket across MCP and web.
- [MCP specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io): Upstream protocol documentation.
